actions.action: Require valid source links before saving definitions
actions.mechanism: A required reference to an existing supplied passage prevents definitions from becoming detached from their evidence.
actions.implementation: Store passage IDs in a supplied-source registry. Require each definition variant to reference an existing ID; prohibit deleting referenced passages.
actions.check: Attempt saves with missing, unknown, and valid IDs. Only the valid case succeeds, and its source link opens the referenced passage.
actions.risk: A valid reference does not establish that wording is supported.

actions.action: Display competing wording beside its source
actions.mechanism: Separate variants preserve disagreement without forcing disputed definitions into a single editorial formulation.
actions.implementation: Give each variant its own wording, passage ID, and stable ID. Add a comparison view showing variants, source passages, and recorded objections.
actions.check: Enter two conflicting definitions. Verify readers can inspect both wordings, each source, and the objection without accessing editor-only controls.
actions.risk: An editorial preference could visually overshadow alternatives; label preference explicitly.

actions.action: Review source changes without silently replacing evidence
actions.mechanism: Versioned passages retain original support while dependency checks identify definitions needing review after a source edit.
actions.implementation: Assign changed passages new IDs and link their predecessors. Flag dependent variants for review; retain their original wording and references until explicitly revised.
actions.check: Edit a passage supporting two variants. Both receive review flags; their original passages remain inspectable, and neither reference changes automatically.
actions.risk: Review flags may accumulate; they must not hide existing definitions.

actions.action: Make competing wording searchable and directly shareable
actions.mechanism: Indexing every variant lets readers discover disagreements even when their search uses wording absent from the preferred definition.
actions.implementation: Index all variant text and passage IDs locally. Return term-grouped results with matched wording, dispute indicators, and stable links to individual variants.
actions.check: Search a phrase unique to a nonpreferred variant. Its result appears, and its direct link exposes that wording, source, and competing definition.
actions.risk: Grouping must not conceal which variant actually matched the query.
